clara.evaluate_metric_v2.note: Wave F Track-A, F-A5b CARD 1: the substitution seam's stage-(b) evaluator -- v1's grammar plus ONE closed leaf kind, `cell`, which resolves an already-minted, definition-backed metric_cells row. A NEW _vN beside the frozen v1, never a recut of it: v1's four bodies are members of a deployed closure and clara.verify_evaluator_freeze() re-derives their hashes LIVE from the catalog between every migration body and its commit, so an in-place edit fails at APPLY, not merely at review. UNDEPLOYED and born so: 0060's _tf_evaluator_deploy_once makes the flip a one-way ceremony act under the bare migration principal, and _eta_compose_metric_preview_core_v2 refuses `evaluator_undeployed` until it runs -- so stage (b) ships DARK, which is the expected post-merge state and not a defect. It is named clara.evaluate_* DELIBERATELY: this lint discovers only that spelling, so a vocabulary reachable only through underscore-named cores would be catalog-frozen at apply and INVISIBLE to review. Its DB-side closure is NINE members -- the four v2 bodies plus the five v1 helpers reused verbatim (_metric_selector_account_ids, _metric_input_dataset_v1, _metric_context_sha256_v1, _metric_resolved_inputs_sha256_v1, _hash). v1's tenth member, clara.evaluate_fs_pack_v1, is DELIBERATELY not a member of v2's: it is pinned to v1's entrypoint and is no part of v2's determinism, so freezing it here would assert a closure v2 does not have. The entry is hand-inserted rather than --update re-baselined so this PR blesses ONE body and re-hashes nobody else's.
